change: Persist an arbitrary readable local ROM folder and last browser-selected ROM/BIOS URLs, with an independent asynchronous file/folder picker
hardware: Linux x86_64 cloud host; Temurin 21.0.8+9; Maven 3.9.11

behavior.menu: Home / ROM folder / Browse folders / Use this folder / Save folder
behavior.rom_browse: Open game / Browse ROM starts in the saved directory; other storage roots remain navigable
behavior.default: All storage roots (file:///), without a fixed SD-card folder
behavior.persistence: Independent version-1 library RMS profile, bounded 512-character URLs; Unicode and percent escapes round-trip unchanged
behavior.folder_change: Clear the previous ROM selection and retain the independent BIOS selection
behavior.io: JSR-75 file access through device permissions; folder/file reading runs in the picker thread; selection callbacks do not depend on the canvas
behavior.cancellation: Suppress stale results/failures after Back; reject old list commands
behavior.files: Unpacked GBA files and case-insensitive .gba/.bin picker filters; battery/state storage behavior remains unchanged

validation.native_runtime: Host filesystem/UI doubles exercise the actual native picker; physical BBOS behavior is not inferred

native_build.signing: No signing step performed by the SDK build script

release_policy: Development source committed/pushed only; no tag or release ZIP without explicit user approval
